look_here_first: Look for enormous bluish-glaucous, mostly basal leaves and tall, relatively leafless flowering stalks topped by large heads with dramatically elongated dark cones and drooping yellow rays. Compare foliage and cone height, not ray color alone.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Large, colony-forming perennial with towering flowering stems.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Very large blue-green glaucous leaves concentrated at the base.

key_traits.label: Heads
key_traits.text: Yellow rays droop beneath an unusually tall, dark elongated disk cone.
